summary: The fund is an actively managed ETF that aims to provide the benefits of partial equity exposure while mitigating the risk posed by a decline in U.S. equity markets. It seeks to achieve these goals by combining: (1) an investment of substantially all its assets in a portfolio of short-term income-generating debt securities with (2) a modest investment in put options on securities or indexes that are representative of U.S. large capitalization companies.
